preconditions.description: The grid dimensions n and m must be between 1 and 2500, and the number of actions q must be between 1 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t <= 3 and 1 <= r1 <= n and 1 <= r2 <= n and 1 <= c1 <= m and 1 <= c2 <= m for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions)
preconditions.description: Each action must have a valid type t and coordinates (r1, c1, r2, c2) within the grid boundaries.

preconditions.expression: all((t == 1 or t == 2) and 2 <= r1 <= r2 <= n - 1 and 2 <= c1 <= c2 <= m - 1 for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions if t in (1, 2))
preconditions.description: For actions of type 1 and 2, the coordinates must be within the inner grid boundaries.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'Yes' if any((t == 3 and is_feasible(r1, c1, r2, c2)) for t, r1, c1, r2, c2 in actions) else 'No'
postconditions.description: For each action of type 3, output 'Yes' if the path is feasible, otherwise output 'No'.
